interface.signature: maxScoreWords(words: List[str], letters: List[str], score: List[int]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of words must be between 1 and 14.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) <= 15 for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each word must have a length between 1 and 15.
The number of letters must be between 1 and 100.
The score list must contain exactly 26 elements.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s <= 10 for s in score)
preconditions.description: Each score in the score list must be between 0 and 10.
All letters must be lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in word) for word in words)
preconditions.description: All characters in each word must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The returned maximum score must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum(score[ord(c) - ord('a')] for c in word) for word in words if all(letters.count(c) >= word.count(c) for c in set(word)))
postconditions.description: The returned score must be the maximum possible score of any valid set of words formed by the given letters.
